nom: Lancôme Advanced Génifique Eye Light Pearl De-puffing Eye Serum

avis.texte: Whenever I run out of this product, I notice a difference. It definitely helps with de-puffing around the eye area and fortifying lashes. Scrape off the tip so the liquid does not go into your eyes.

avis.titre: I have purchased this expensive serum over & over
avis.texte: Serum product is outstanding but adding the delivery system is over the top! Such a great way to glide it on, makes it more like spa treatment than a daily duty.
The best serum on the market!!! I've used it for years. My eyes and lashes look amazing!!!!
Very refreshing but be careful of getting in your eyes. Really stings.

avis.titre: No improvement; pills around the eyes
avis.texte: I've only been using it for about a month, and haven't noticed any change to my dark circles and bags. Also, once it dries, it "pills" horribly. If you use it along the lash line as it recommends, the pilling gets in your eyes and it's very irritating. And also, because of the pilling, you can't wear it under makeup. I will not be buying this again.

avis.titre: Absolute favorite lash enhancer/ depuffer combo
avis.texte: This is my second bottle and i always make it stretch because i love how much it makes my lashes grow. I think my puffiness is genetic so what can ya do. Only reason we have to part ways is due to the Price.

No results. It doesn't do anything to your eyes. Before my purchase, I read the positive comments only, really hoping that was going to be my experience. I should've noticed that there were several negative comments too. Don't waste your money. Not worth it.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I have only used it for a few day now but it seems to be working .

This was a game changer for my aging 57 year old eyes. I keep it in the refrigerator. Each night before bed I massage the cold stainless steal with the serum under my eyes and on my eye lids. The results started to show the first morning. My eyes were visibly brighter, less puffy, less wrinkles, and appeared less sunken in. I did not have any irritation in or around my eyes. I highly recommend!

I used this product for three months. It was going great, until I woke up one day with a STYE. The small glands that line my waterline got plugged. I know it was the product because I tried to use it a couple months after my stye cleared. I ended up with a stye again. I just think that even when using the applicator on clean hands, then applying it to under eyes; still makes it unsanitary. Plus the price makes this product not worth it.
One week morning and night-the puffiness is reduced to a minimum with my morning ritual taking it away for the day. Lines are invisible in the mornings and at night time to reapply.
This product made my eyes itch terribly. I only used it one time and I was not surprised that I had a reaction to it because I have reactions to many eye products.

avis.titre: I use Lancome products and this is one of them
avis.texte: This is the best I love it I also use other products from Lancôme and love there products thank you
Good product for me, I used this product many years, it is good for my skin!
I am loving my serum. The results are mind blowing. A friend of mine introduced me to this serum and I cannot believe it wasn't already a part of my skincare regimen. I can't do without it!

avis.titre: Very hydrating, helpful at keeping fine lines at b
avis.texte: Been using for several years. Been very helpful at keeping fine lines & wrinkles at bay. Very creamy & hydrating. The applicator is great at inlike keeping itbin the fridge to keep it cool. Highly recommended
Quickly absorbed, this serum is effective and easy to use. It absorbs so quickly that I don't even need to use one of my devices that gently push serums into my skin!
Love love this eye serum, I also apply on my lashes and my lashes seem longer and fuller.
I think this works very well for under my eyes. I also think that it helps with my thinning eyebrows.

avis.titre: Pearl eye serum is an everyday must!
avis.texte: In my previous review I told you my everyday routine. I wash my face and put warm water on my eyes. Then I apply the cold serum to my warm eyes and using my 4th finger on each hand, gently circle the serum around my entire eye area. It feels wonderful and my eyes immediately lose the morning puffiness.
Love how it feels on my eyes, and the results it's had over the years reducing fine lines and wrinkles
Love this! Will definitely get this again! Would also recommend! Like to see more reasonable prices!
I have been using this product for several years and have been very pleased with the results.

Serum very light and creamy ! I love the applicator too. The serum is so light and creamy. I love the benefits of this serum. This was very hydrating and I loved the applicator- very cooling. Absorbs quickly and non-greasy.
I like how this product keeps my skin around my eye smooth and soft. I would definitely recommend it.
I've been using this product for about 8 months now and the area around my eyes has become smooth and my concealer goes on perfect!
Great to reduce the puffiness under and around my eyes. I wear lash extensions, so I can't tell if it has effected the length/integrity of my lashes.
I have been using this brand for a while helps wirh the firming of my eye helps frow my lashes and tones well would recommend
I've used this product ever since it first came out and I will never go without it around my eye area ! It works as a great anti -aging preventative !
Works well on my skin, will definitely recommend this product!
Best eye serum I've ever used. Smoothes out fine lines and wrinkles. Plumps the skin.
This product give my eyes some cool sense. It is soothing and makes me feel great.
I found that a little goes a long way, making it a worthwhile investment for anyone looking to address multiple concerns around the eyes.

I've been using this serum for over a year now. I use it in combination with the eye cream and I've definitely seen great results. Using it alone has given me a more "awake" look. Overall I feel my eyes have that youthful look thanks to this product.
Light weight serum that helps reduce puffiness and dark circles under eyes. I love this product!! I usually keep an extra one on hand so I never run out.
Sorry to say, this product does nothing for wrinkles or puffiness and does not make your eyelashes grow. Very disappointed because I don't usually pay this high price for eye serums
I really hope it works well for me but so far still couldn't tell any change except the tingling sensation every time I applied it around my eyes.
This is an absolute must have daily for me! Does wonders for my eyes and the bags under my eyes!
Love the silver ball applicator. Smooths the serum on your eye area. I have had great results. No more puffy eyes or dark circles. Love this serum!!
This always keeps the muscles around my eyes hydrated. I like the cool effect of the applicator. It seems to wake up my early morning eyes.
I have been using this product for a while and it works right away.
Love the way this glides in under my eyes & gives an instant cooling effect! Definitely feel it's a bonus to my morning routine!!
Love this product it helps brighten around my eyes Been using it for years
Genifique Light Pearl Eye Cream is another great addition to the Genefique family of skin care products.
This is my third bottle I combines with Génifique eye cream they work great together
I love this eye serum . Goes on smoothly and love the applicator!

avis.titre: Sorry not working out for me
avis.texte: It really does not work… the illusion of relief I guess Sorry

avis.titre: Lancome Advanced Genifique Light Pearl Eye Serum
avis.texte: Excellent product. You can see the difference once you begin to use this Eye Serum. I highly recommend it.

avis.titre: Perfect go to for tired eyes
avis.texte: Absolutely love this product. Quickly refreshes eyes and bags under eyes!
I was excited to get this. Considering its Lancome and the price, I expected results. Ive been using it for nearly 8 weeks. Its done absolutely nothing, but in fact, my eyes have a darker hue now.

avis.titre: New must have for morning routine
avis.texte: I really love this serum and now it's a part of my morning routine. Helps to fight puffiness
obsessed!! Especially, when my eyes are puffy and dryer than usual. highly recommend
Great product that my skin appearance appears brighter and healthie.r
I have been using genifique eye for years, and have shared it with my sister and sister in laws and friends. It is a great product that I never live without!
Love it! Lightweight, brightening and cooling eye serum is perfect for my puffy eye area.

This product is amazing. It goes on silky soft with the cool, metal, pearl-shaped wand. My eyes have never looked less puffy & my "laugh lines" are barely visible!! I love it!! Even my lashes look fuller.
This serum has made such an amazing impact on my eyes. It reduces puffiness and tightens at the same time. Very effective!
I have been using this eye serum for years! recommended for sure!
It definitely reduces puffiness and wrinkles around the eye. I love this product!

avis.titre: this product is amazing my skin looks hydrated
avis.texte: great experience with this product,leaves my skin super hydrated
Where has this been all my adult life? It's so great that I got my 65 mother hooked on it. It's such a treat to apply first thing in the morning, the cooling serum and applicator is to die for!
Fabulous like a miracle! My eyes have never looked better! Even after the first use!

avis.titre: A must for circles and wrinkles around eyes!
avis.texte: I've noticed an improvement in the wrinkles around my eyes (less exaggerated) and the circles under my eyes are lighter. I also noticed that this has helped my lashes grow longer!

avis.titre: Love My Genifique Light Pearl Eye Serum
avis.texte: I use this serum every day and I believe it really helps me keep a youthful glow! Look forward to keeping my supply full and available.
ADDICT SINCE I FIRST STARTED USING IT, IT REFRESHENS THE AREA NEAR YOUR EYES, THE APPLICATOR IS ALWAYS COLD GIVING A GREAT FEELING.
Love this product. It smooths and reduces fine wrinkles around the eyes.
best moisturizer the applicator is unique, easy to use and most importantly sanitary i love the cooling sensation
This serum is amazing. I also use it on my lashes and they have grown so much. Definitely recommend this if you are trying to grow your lashes.
This product is not great, just okay. I was hopeful it would cut down puffiness under my eyes. However that is not the case. It is basically a moisturizer.
I love the metal applicator. It's a cooling effect and the serum is great. Noticeable improvement in lashes and dark circles.
Probably the best eye serum I ever used for reducing puffiness under the eyes. And it's very lightweight.
I love using this product for my aging skin. My skin has gott Dry as I've aged and this makes my under eyes more plump and less saggy

This is my second bottle of this eye serum. I have terribly sensitive skin and have spent too much money on "trying" products. I have finally found one that doesn't bother my skin and does help with my under eye puffiness (I'm 70).
This product truly works for reducing puffy eyes, I have used it for years!!
It's smoothing the fine lines and wrinkles while helping my lashes and brows to become thicker!
I use the Genifique Light Pearl Eye Serum every day and have found that it reduces the puffiness around my eyes.
Works wonders on my skin around my eyes leaves my eyes with a fresh glow around them.

I love this product line so decided to try the Eye Serum. Firstly the applicator dispenses way too much product and I put too much on my eyes. I had a burning sensation right after using this and had to cleanse my face immediately. I tried again after reading your How to Apply instructions and spent minutes each time scraping the applicator to reduce the amount of product I used. I persevered for a few weeks, then went back to using the Absolue eye cream, as I saw no beneficial changes using the serum. Sorry, I am disappointed as I am a big Lancome user.

This product is a game changer. I am 43 years old and looked tired all the time. I was tired of hearing peoples compliments in how tired I looked. This serum has help me look refreshed even when I am tired. My puffiness and under circles are gone. Thank you Lancome for making products that work at a reasonable price.
This product brightens, smooths, and adds more moisture under eye cream.

I have been using light Pearl eye serum since it was a launched. When I first started using it my eyebrows were getting thin and scarce. I used the serum on my eyebrows and avrosz the lash line as well as around my eyes as directed. My eyebrows and lashes have filled in. My eye area is brighter and it's kept the lines at bay. A must have.

After applying this product a couple of times, my eyes started to feel heavy and itchy! It doesn't reduce eye bags or easy wrinkles! All it does is irritations! Some of Lancôme products are not effective but not causing irritation either! But this one is certainly a BAD one!
Rolling the serum under my eyes instantly brightens and minimizes my dark circles! The cool feeling adds to the experience.
I am 66 y/o. I have dark circles around my eyes. I am using this product to hopefully see a difference.

avis.titre: Not sure if I like this product yet.
avis.texte: It's only been a couple months since using this product. Not sure if I see too much of a difference in the reduction of my eye bags yet. Will finish this bottle and see if I want to continue it then.
I love the texture and tools inside the bottle. It is convenient and easy to use daily in your skincare routine.

avis.titre: It is one of my favorite product from lancome
avis.texte: I like to apply this product around my eyes twice a day before the cream. I have been using it for years. It is a little pricey right now but it is worthy.
Light texture and non-greasy formula is perfect for eye lids which are often neglected in daily skin care routine. I highly recommend.
I tried many different eye serums and I am in love with this one. Refreshing and rejuvenating
Make such a difference in the appearance of your eyes. They appear brighter and refreshed.
I have been using Advanced Génifique Yeux Light-Pearl for 5 years, with no more puffiness or dark spots under my eyes anymore. But it takes time to recover my skills in the very beginning.
Love Génifique eye light pearl. I've been using it since it came out
This stuff does exactly what it says. No more puffiness nor dark spots under eyes. Awesome, can't do without it.

I was pleasantly surprised at how much I like the Advanced Genifique Light Pearl Eye Serum. It's very lightweight and doesn't weigh down the delicate area under your eye. The pearl applicator is just the right size for that special small area. I thought it would add too much product causing it to get inside my eye. But, it applies just the right amount and gives you that cold therapy sensation while doing so. It's a winner!
I have been using this product over 3 months. It is effective in smoothing the wrinkles below my eyes. I am back to repurchase.
I bought this and been using it faithfully, but sadly, it's done nothing for me…I live ALL Lancome products, but this just did nothing…sorry … expensive and not worth it
Love it. The applicator wand is great. Cooling effect. I like to mix it with the matching eye cream.
I like the feeling and texture but not really see any difference other than easier to put on makeup afterward
This product is amazing. I feel like it's helped me reduce wrinkles and definitely helps with eye puffiness. I highly recommend
So so soothing. I can tell in my skin that it is so appreciative of this treatment!
I won't go one day without this serum. The product truly delivers and my eyes have never looked better. This serum has also helped make my eye lashes healthy again.
This is a very light but nourishing and super absorbent serum.

avis.titre: This eye ser will always be in my skincare arsenal
avis.texte: I love this eye serum! It's the first thing I use every morning as part of my skincare routine. I love the cooling effect, and how it goes to work on de-puffing before applying the rest of the skincare and makeup.
I like this serum very much. The tool is highly appreciated. I have purchased the products many times.
